name: Intune Admin Center Tools
description: Comprehensive tool designed to streamline the management of Microsoft Intune devices. This extension allows administrators to efficiently check application and configuration assignments, manage device groups, download platform scripts, and perform various other administrative tasks.
author: Maciej Horbacz

securityCheck.aiSummary: Foundational security concerns center on credential handling and data exfiltration. The extension captures and stores Microsoft Graph Authorization headers (token harvesting risk) and sends analytics data to an external service (data exfiltration risk). There are placeholders for secrets but no active hardcoded credentials beyond placeholders. No obfuscated code or remote script execution patterns detected. Mitigations include removing/renaming token capture or securing storage and access, restricting analytics data, and ensuring tokens/data are minimally exposed with explicit opt-in and proper telemetry handling.
